reviews.author: Kim Reagin
reviews.text: This business is hands down the very best. They aim to please and they go above and beyond. Each person I encountered was very professional and so respectful and friendly. Thank you to Chaney’s for taking care of my HVAC needs, promptly.

reviews.author: Chris Curreri
reviews.text: Always get top notch service with these guys. Just an honest genuine company. They installed our new system and have done lots of work for several of our clients. I've only heard good things from everyone. They also give back a lot to their community. This is the kind of local company you want to support!

reviews.author: Kim Lambert
reviews.text: We had our Summer Service and Maintenance on our HVAC & Mini-split system last week, Chaney's continues to provide a great service. Drew was knowledgeable, efficient, and very professional, He did a great job!

reviews.author: Melissa C Larson
reviews.text: Daniel came out in the storm. He was very nice, explained the issue and stayed until he got our AC running again. Always get great service but he went above and beyond.

reviews.author: Sharolyn Goodman
reviews.text: Install of a new GREE Mini Split unit for a Nail Salon. The existing unit was mounted on the exterior wall of the building and caused vibration and noise inside. (Previous unit was not installed by Chaneys.) Camden and Mac removed the old unit and replaced it with a new 18k BTU GREE Mini Split unit. They reconfigured all the electrical and installed using a slab method on the ground. This resolved the vibration and noise from the previous unit. This also provided a cleaner appearance for the outside of the salon. The turn around time from the first visit to install was a matter of days. Camden also made sure the old unit kept cooling the best it could until the new unit arrived. He followed up a few days after the first visit to make sure it was still cooling. The office manager was very nice and professional and called me within the hour following my acceptance of the estimate for the new installation. I was scheduled for the installation on a day and time that worked perfectly for my schedule. I also talked with the owner Travis to confirm the installation day and time. He was so nice and professional as well. Thanks to Camden providing the temp fix on the old unit and a quick turnaround for the new unit I had zero impact to my business. I highly recommend this company to anyone needing HVAC services. He also has me setup for maintenance twice a year on my home and business. They cleaned and provided maintenance to my home unit ensuring we are good to go for the upcoming summer heat. Fairly priced, professional, clean and a quick turnaround.

reviews.author: Jessica Muckenfuss
reviews.text: Amazing customer service and communication. The service men were kind and helpful. The owner Travis is extremely professional and his employees are great. Very quick to get an appointment and a very quick service. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.text: I was referred to this company by Ben. These are some of the most professional HVAC employees I’ve ever seen. Very thorough work and excellent results. I will definitely be calling these guys for any future HVAC repairs or maintenance.

reviews.author: Jason Lambert
reviews.text: I called Chaney's yesterday and the person I spoke with was super nice and very helpful. She had one of their HVAC specialists, Travis, drop by this morning to inspect my HVAC/Furnace and give me estimates on a few modifications and additions. He went the extra mile in explaining every detail on the operation of my unit. I felt like I learned more from him than any from HVAC class. Extremely knowledgeable and kind guy. This is a great company with helpful, professional, and very skilled employees. I give them the highest recommendation!

reviews.author: Angela Redden
reviews.text: Chaney's got me through all the ice and snow this year. Very friendly and knowledgeable. Even checked to see if my unit was still under warranty.

reviews.author: Jean and Mike Bufford
reviews.text: We needed a new gas pack and Chaney’s delivered, installed and were very efficient. Joseph and Charlie were very courteous and knowledgeable installers. On a previous check up, Cameron Lollis had discovered a hole in our heat exchange which could have caused carbon monoxide to come in the house. Drew Hinson was an excellent assistant as well. Recommend Chaney’s Heating and Cooling highly.

reviews.author: Jason Hayes
reviews.text: Travis was very courteous and professional. They did outstanding work and finished earlier than expected. They moved our 2 units to a better location. We thought we would be without air overnight but they got the units hooked up and running so that we would have air. Definitely recommend them and will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: April Summer
reviews.text: We thank you for the wonderful service that you gave to us. We give you a 5 for your knowledge and your friendly service. Carroll and April

reviews.author: Dan Besser
reviews.text: After getting various options and opinions on how to solve my AC issues, my neighbor recommended that I call Chaney’s AC. Travis came out and we discussed the problems and what he thought was the best solution. The team did an excellent job in a very timely manner replacing the AC , ductwork and installation of the vapor barrier which solved all the problems. I highly recommend them for their excellent work and integrity

reviews.author: David Marshall
reviews.text: After meeting with Travis, everything is good .Travis is true to his word and stands firm with the success of his business. I would call him if I need service in the future

reviews.author: Alicia Neuhaus
reviews.text: A locally owned and operated company that cares about their customers. Top tier service and installation. The entire team was so great to work with.

reviews.author: Brook Johnson
reviews.text: I had an outstanding experience with Chaney's Heating & Cooling. From the moment I called, their customer service was responsive, friendly, and professional. Their team went above and beyond to ensure my AC was up and running as quickly as possible. It’s rare to find a company that’s this reliable, honest, and knowledgeable. Highly recommend Chaney's to anyone in need of heating and cooling services, I'll definitely be using them again in the future!

reviews.author: Vickie
reviews.text: A great group of people to do business with. Very professional all the way around. So if you need help call Chaney's heating and cooling in Ninety Six. Thank you Travis for a job well done

reviews.author: DORIS ARTZ
reviews.text: Was having issues with my clothes dryer and was fortunate to have Benjamin and Jordan come to my aid. The dryer vent hose had come loose, and lint was flying everywhere. The vent tube coming out of the wall was too short making it difficult to reconnect the new hose, but they worked on it until the connection was solid. It took some time, but they patiently persevered. Thanks guys.

reviews.author: Jennifer Nardelli
reviews.text: This is the company you will want to call!! They were available and contacted me on the weekend. Sent a trained professional out on the weekend!! They had our unit up and running in no time. Trustworthy and knowledgeable, we would never pick anyone over them. They have been amazing to our family.

reviews.author: Philicia Beaube
reviews.text: Excellent experience from start to finish. Camden explained everything clearly. In less than 24 hours my heater was running perfectly. I’ll definitely call Chaney’s again.

reviews.author: Duncan
reviews.text: Completed a new install of my hvac system and I couldn’t be happier. My ac went out on a super hot weekend and Travis had someone at my house that same day to fix the system until a new unit could come in. All the guys were great and completed the work even on a super hot day. We are beyond grateful.

reviews.author: Shagadad
reviews.text: Joseph and Charlie just installed my new HVAC and they did an outstanding job. They were prompt, did a great job and I’ve got cold air again and they did it in 94° heat! I would highly recommend using Chaney’s Heating and Air.

reviews.author: Michael Wells
reviews.text: Hello out there if anyone is looking for quality , respectfully, courteous and prompt heating & cooling team Chaney’s has got you covered and then some..Great rates backed with stand behind warranties duct two houses for me team done an awesome job thoughtfulness supplying portable AC & heaters I can tell you from experience the owner, office worker and technicians are Awesome and thanks again!!

reviews.author: Steve Knepley
reviews.text: Chaney's just replaced our HVAC system. They were professional and timely from the bid process to the installation. Their installation crew did a great job. We love our new system and feel we got a lot for our money. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Dexter Cochran
reviews.text: These guys were great! They came out to the house on short notice, were very thorough and honest about what they were seeing. They got my heat turned back on in a couple hours!

reviews.author: Sarah Darragh
reviews.text: Chaneys Heating and Cooling is a honest company with service techs that go above and beyond for their customers. They take pride in their work and jobs. They are very knowledgeable and offer many options to best met their customers needs.

reviews.author: Terry Creswell
reviews.text: My AC unit stopped today, one of the hottest days of the year. When I called Chaney’s it was almost 5:00 pm but in less than 30 minutes, they had a technician at my house. Jordan worked diligently for 3 hours to get my unit up and running. He was both professional and courteous. I really appreciate the excellent service I always get from Chaney’s Heating and Cooling

reviews.author: Jason Eppley
reviews.text: Travis and his team provide prompt courteous service. I would highly recommend them for any HVAC needs.

reviews.author: Charisma Boyd
reviews.text: Great Service, Employees are very reliable and consistent. Joe Broadway has great experience and customer service skills as well!

reviews.author: Rick Leary
reviews.text: I have used Chaney's for over 15 years for my HVAC needs. They are always responsive and wonderful to work with.

reviews.author: Donna Aga
reviews.text: Arrives on time, cleans after the work, very friendly. I have always had good service from this company.

reviews.author: Maddie F
reviews.text: I highly recommend Chaney’s! The process from start to finish was very smooth and everyone we have talked to has been professional and helpful.

reviews.author: Donna Hall
reviews.text: I’m very pleased with the excellent prompt A/C repair service that Chaney’s provided. Reasonably priced and professional staff!! Thanks!

reviews.author: Adam Creswell
reviews.text: Always prompt & professional, I cannot recommend Chaney's enough. I have utilized their services for both my home and business and can attest to their fast response and exemplary service in both applications.

reviews.author: Drew
reviews.text: I can’t tell you how honest and how responsive Travis and his team are. Five star all day! Chaney’s heating & cooling are the best.

reviews.author: Brad Smith
reviews.text: Had a furnace issue, factory malfunction, they came out quickly and took care of the problem at no charge. I appreciate their attention. Good guys….

reviews.author: Barbara Schlagenhauf
reviews.text: Drew came to help us yesterday. He was 100% terrific in EVERY WAY. POLITE PROFESSIONAL SUCCESSFUL .... I could go on! Super experience . So thankful

reviews.author: Legal Professionals Greenwood
reviews.text: Fast and professional. I have used them on several occasions and the electricians and staff are always great to work with. They have kept my AC unit working for me on many occasions. I am very grateful for their services today as it is very hot out there!

reviews.author: Billy Tunstall
reviews.text: If every company in America was run like this, we'd all be much better off. Chaneys has helped us for years... always on time, usually same-day, completely transparent and fair. Great people from the top all the way down. Nothing but the best.
